name: Mayako Ai
source:
Mayako is someone who doesn't like school but loves sports.
Hibi's best friend, she won't hesitate to hit Toma if he tries to try anything.
[spoiler]Despite the fact that she resists her succubus nature, she can't help but want to find another man to be able to perfect her harem.[/spoiler]
